situation: Initial situation refined by the coordinator
goal: Goal refined by the coordinator; empty if unspecified; never shown to characters
non_participants: Names of absent people who may be mentioned but never participate
beginning_narration: Narration describing the situation at the beginning of the conversation

character.name: The name of the character taking this turn
character.speech: What the character says aloud; empty string allowed
character.thought: What the character thinks but does not say aloud; empty string allowed
character.narration: Original narration generated by the character; empty string allowed
character.expression: The character's facial expression; empty string allowed

turns.narration: Definitive narration revised by the coordinator
turns.progress_reason: Coordinator assessment; never shown to characters

ending_narration: Narration describing the situation at the end of the conversation
stop_reason: The reason why the conversation generation stopped
